reader.requirement: At 1985 the compiler must accept any number of level-66 RENAMES entries following a logical record (in any section that holds record description entries, each record of an FD separately), each binding its own alias, overlapping or not.

edition-consulted.switches: operand candidate set: record subtree from 2002, whole scope below 2002 (then IsWithinRegion); not the count of entries
Edition.Cite chooses the 1985 or 2023 citation text in the message only

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|Edition.Is in DataBinder.RenamesEntry.cs and ResolveRedefinesPass.cs; grep -i renames in Validation/*.cs and WiseOwl.Cobol.Editions: no gate on the number of 66 entries; BindRenames appends every alias to owner.Renames66 (a list) at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness has two 66 entries on one WS record; not exercised are FD records with several aliases each, a second record's aliases, overlapping aliases and aliases used as receiving items

probes.printed: R1=AB R2=ABCD R3=CD12 / R4=CD12EF R5=ABCD12EF R6=12 / C=13 / S1=PQRS S2=RS / W2=PQZZ / FAB=1122 FBC=2233 / FY=YYY FXY=XXXYYY (exit 0)
probes.expected: six aliases on W1, two on W2, two on each of two FD records all accepted; each alias reads and writes its own range (GR1/GR2)
aliases of both records of one sequential FD bind to their own record

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR1  (║5.11.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: SR1 is permissive; the binder keeps a list of aliases per record and the probe binds ten aliases over four records (two FD, two WS), overlapping, elementary, group and numeric-elementary, and reads and writes through them correctly at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probed the record kinds the reader did not: a LINKAGE record with four 66 entries (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/reread-1985-moved/out/refute-1985-m02/src/rn_link.cob, runs/rn_link-001: LR1=ABCD LR2=CDEF LR3=EF LR4=ABCDEF, MOVE through LR3 reaches the caller: BACK ABCDZZ); two SD records each with two 66 entries, one qualified by record and SD file-name (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/reread-1985-moved/out/refute-1985-m02/src/rn_sd.cob, runs/rn_sd-002: GOT 01AAA V=AAA K2=01 Q=AAA / GOT 02BBB ...); a CD FOR INPUT record with three 66 entries, one qualified by record and cd-name (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/reread-1985-moved/out/refute-1985-m02/src/rn_cd.cob, runs/rn_cd-001: Q=QUEUE1 ... SSS). The refusal half: a 66 after a level-77 is refused by SR2 and SR4 (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/reread-1985-moved/out/refute-1985-m02/src/rn_nonrec.cob: COBOL2740 x2). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR1  (5.11.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'. Every logical-record kind of 1985 (FD, SD, CD, WS, LINKAGE) takes any number of RENAMES entries.
